notes: Built from USAspending spending_by_award search responses (POST, archived with request body in raw/manifest.jsonl, source_id usaspending-post). Amount = USAspending 'Award Amount' (cumulative federal obligation, not a ceiling and not an announced figure); disbursed_usd = 'Total Outlays' when present. Dates = 'Base Obligation Date' (first obligation), else 'Start Date'. Search was recipient-name text on awarding agency = Department of Energy over 2007-10-01..2026-09-30 and one page of up to 50 rows per award-type group; awards with zero or negative net obligation are omitted. Recipient name variants not matched by the name search may be missing. Government record, basis=disclosed. VERIFIER (2026-10-05): every row re-checked against the archived search snapshot (amount, outlays, base obligation date all match) and against a per-award USAspending award-detail snapshot (api/v2/awards/<id>/, source verify-usaspending). Rows are award-level aggregates, so each event is one award, not a modification. Participant evidence now quotes the award's assistance-listing title or awarding office from the award-detail snapshot (the old quote only said 'Department of Energy'); obligated_usd now has its own evidence ("total_obligation"). Where the search row showed 'Total Outlays' 0.0 but the award detail has total_outlay null (no File C outlay reporting, typical for pre-2020 or brand-new awards), disbursed_usd was removed: 0.0 meant 'not reported', not 'nothing paid'. DEFG0207ER84691 ($371,179, signed 2009-07-29) is the same DOE grant DE-FG02-07ER84691 as FG02-07ER84691 ($841,835) under the post-2009 ID format; same title, same end date. The legacy record's total already appears to include the 2009 obligations (841,835 - 371,179 = ~470K, which fits Phase I plus Phase II year 1), so the 2009 record is marked duplicate. DEMS0000131 (MESC, $80.0M obligated, outlays not reported, $100.7M non-federal cost share, period 2025-2026) has had no money disbursed as far as USAspending shows; status after the 2025 DOE award reviews is not confirmed.
